D/ DN VALENTIN[IAN]VS AVGG[...] ; R/ GLORIA [ROMAN]ORVM FN in

Roman coin, copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian (AD 364-375) Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece Period 19, AD 364-378. Obverse: Pearl diademed bust, right 'DN VALENTINIANVS PF AVG'. Reverse: Emperor with standard dragging a captive, right, 'GLORIA ROMANORVM' FN in field. Lugdunum Mint. Obverse description: Pearl diademed bust, right.
